questions.question: Tell me a service that can be used to simulate a critical infrastructure
questions.myAnswer: CI-SIM (Critical Infrastructure Simulation), provided by Montimage
questions.note: Ambiguity: secSIM is also called an assurance-driven simulator, but the dedicated critical-infrastructure simulation entry is CI-SIM.

questions.question: Which services come from Tecnalia?
questions.myAnswer: SECINTERP, SECSAC, SECASSURE4AI, SECATTSIM

questions.question: I am looking for tools and services related to the Energy sector, which ones are they?
questions.myAnswer: UIH-PROSUMER (Prosumer Cell), SPS-DEVSECOPS (DevSecOps Architecture), PPC-EMOB (E-mobility Testing Facilities), PPC-IIOT (PPC IIoT Lab)

questions.question: List the catalog entries that are not pure software offerings
questions.myAnswer: Software/Hardware: ORO-5GLAB, SAVVY-DEVSRV, IDEKO-CNC, PPC-IIOT, AALTO-EDGE5G. Hardware: ORO-3GPP16, ITPAERO-CLUSTER, ITPAERO-CFAA, UIH-PROSUMER, PPC-EMOB, AST-DEDISRV, AALTO-LUMI. (12 entries total)

questions.question: Which services have a license entry other than TBD?
questions.myAnswer: KAFKA (Apache-2.0) and the 14 partner infrastructure entries marked 'N/A (Partner Infrastructure)' — ORO-5GLAB, ORO-3GPP16, ITPAERO-CLUSTER, ITPAERO-CFAA, SAVVY-DEVSRV, IDEKO-CNC, UIH-PROSUMER, SPS-DEVSECOPS, TELLU-CARE, PPC-EMOB, PPC-IIOT, AST-DEDISRV, AALTO-LUMI, AALTO-EDGE5G. 15 in total.

questions.question: Which 5G testbeds are not run by Orange Romania?
questions.myAnswer: AALTO-EDGE5G (Edge Devices & 5G Testbed)

questions.question: Do we have any security services still below TRL 4?
questions.myAnswer: Yes: SECSAC (secSAC) and SECDEVTWIN (SecDevTwin), both at current TRL 3

questions.question: Which entries in the catalog are already at TRL 9?
questions.myAnswer: KAFKA plus the 14 partner infrastructure entries (every infrastructure entry is at TRL 9): ORO-5GLAB, ORO-3GPP16, ITPAERO-CLUSTER, ITPAERO-CFAA, SAVVY-DEVSRV, IDEKO-CNC, UIH-PROSUMER, SPS-DEVSECOPS, TELLU-CARE, PPC-EMOB, PPC-IIOT, AST-DEDISRV, AALTO-LUMI, AALTO-EDGE5G. 15 in total — CI-SIM and all other tools are below 9.

questions.question: Of the security tools in the Dev Services and Ops Services categories (not counting the Kafka message broker), which ones have reached TRL 5 or higher?
questions.myAnswer: CSAM (5), SECNCD (5), SECVDR (5), SECAISOAR (6)
questions.note: KAFKA is in Ops Services at TRL 9 but is a message broker, so the question excludes it explicitly.

questions.question: How many services in the whole catalog does Montimage provide?
questions.myAnswer: 8: SECSIM, SECAISOAR, MAG, HTTP-SIM, MMT-PROBE, SECANOD, CI-SIM, AI4SOAR

questions.question: How many services in the catalog are software only, having no hardware component?
questions.myAnswer: 20 — the 11 dev/ops security services, MAG, HTTP-SIM, MMT-PROBE, SECANOD, KAFKA, AI4SOAR, CI-SIM, SPS-DEVSECOPS and TELLU-CARE

questions.question: How many entries support the smart charging use case (UC5)?
questions.myAnswer: 2: PPC-EMOB and PPC-IIOT (both from PPC)

questions.question: What is the lowest current TRL among our security services, and which tool holds it?
questions.myAnswer: TRL 3, held by SECSAC (Security Assurance Case Tool) and SECDEVTWIN (Assurance-driven Security Development Twin)

questions.question: Looking only at the tools and services provided by Montimage, which one is the most mature right now?
questions.myAnswer: MMT-PROBE (MMT Traffic Analysis Probe) at current TRL 7

questions.question: Among the services wired into our attack-detect-respond demo, which one currently has the highest TRL?
questions.myAnswer: KAFKA at TRL 9 (the other four: MAG 6, CI-SIM 6, SECANOD 6, AI4SOAR 5)

questions.question: Among the providers, who provides the most tools and services?
questions.myAnswer: Montimage (MTI) with 8

questions.question: Considering all the infrastructures over the NIS2 sectors — which sector has the most infrastructure?
questions.myAnswer: Energy with 4 (UIH-PROSUMER, SPS-DEVSECOPS, PPC-EMOB, PPC-IIOT)
questions.note: Only the partner infrastructure entries carry a sector; Digital infrastructure and Manufacturing tie at 3.

questions.question: Which use case do the most of the infrastructures items support?
questions.myAnswer: Cross-cutting infrastructure support (SAVVY-DEVSRV, IDEKO-CNC, AST-DEDISRV — 3 items)
questions.note: Partner infrastructure = the hardware testbeds / non-toolbox list. UC1–UC5 and Research support each have 2 or fewer.

questions.question: Which Energy-sector infrastructure is pure hardware, which mean it's not software or a hybrid)?
questions.myAnswer: UIH-PROSUMER (Prosumer Cell) and PPC-EMOB (E-mobility Testing Facilities)
questions.note: PPC-IIOT is Software/Hardware and SPS-DEVSECOPS is Software, so they don't count as pure hardware.

questions.question: Which Montimage tools are expected to reach TRL 8 but are still at TRL 6 or below today?
questions.myAnswer: SECANOD (6), MAG (6), HTTP-SIM (6), CI-SIM (6), AI4SOAR (5); MMT-PROBE is excluded (already at 7), SECSIM and SECAISOAR expect only 7
questions.note: Replaced the terminal-UI question: the uiType field (MAG = web) contradicted MAG's description (driven from a shell).

questions.question: Do we have anything in the operations category from SINTEF? Which service is it?
questions.myAnswer: Yes: SECOPSTWIN (Assurance-driven Security Operation Twin), current TRL 4 — SINTEF's other service, SECDEVTWIN, is in the dev category

questions.question: Which services are used in the Montimage demo scenario (the attack → MMT detection → AI4SOAR block one)?
questions.myAnswer: MAG, CI-SIM, SECANOD, KAFKA, AI4SOAR (5 services)

questions.question: Which catalog services are left out of the Montimage demo scenario (not used in it at all)?
questions.myAnswer: All 32 catalog services minus MAG, CI-SIM, SECANOD, KAFKA, AI4SOAR — 27 services: the 11 dev/ops security services, MMT-PROBE and HTTP-SIM, and the 14 infrastructure entries other than CI-SIM

questions.question: Who supplies the alert bus that the demo scenario runs on?
questions.myAnswer: Apache Software Foundation (KAFKA, the single-node Kafka broker used to carry secAnoD alerts to AI4SOAR)

questions.question: Do you know which tools or services are provided by Fraunhofer Fokus or CERTH
questions.myAnswer: CSAM (Fraunhofer Fokus), SECNCD and SECVDR (CERTH)

questions.question: Which services reference at least two security standards in their catalog entry?
questions.myAnswer: CSAM (7 standards: ISO/IEC 15408, EUCC, EN 17927, EN 17640, Cyber Security Act, Cyber Resilience Act, AI Act) and SECINTERP (3: IEC 62443-4-2, IEEE 1686, IEC 62351)
questions.note: All other entries list at most one standard.

questions.question: Rank the top 3 services by how many standards they map to
questions.myAnswer: 1. CSAM (7), 2. SECINTERP (3), 3. a four-way tie at one standard: SECSAC (OSCAL), ORO-5GLAB, ORO-3GPP16 and AALTO-EDGE5G (3GPP)
questions.note: Third place is tied; eval should accept any order among the single-standard entries.

questions.question: Is there any service that appears in every scenario we have on the platform? If so, name them
questions.myAnswer: No: the platform has two scenarios and the 'DDoS attack' scenario has no services yet, so no service is in every scenario. (The only populated scenario, the attack → MMT detection → AI4SOAR block demo, has MAG, CI-SIM, SECANOD, KAFKA, AI4SOAR.)
questions.note: Corrected after the check: the catalog has 2 scenarios, one of them empty. Accept an answer that says no common service, or that names the 5 demo services while explicitly noting the empty DDoS scenario.

questions.question: Which of our tools that are compliant with ISO/IEC 27001?
questions.myAnswer: none
questions.note: Nothing lists ISO/IEC 27001; CSAM's closest entry is ISO/IEC 15408.

questions.question: Do we have any pure hardware offering that is driven from a terminal?
questions.myAnswer: none
questions.note: The only terminal-UI entry in the catalog is KAFKA (software); every hardware entry has a web interface.

questions.question: What exactly does secAttSIM do for us in operations?
questions.myAnswer: It is the Attack and Incident Simulator: white-box and black-box adversarial AI attacks for operation scenarios, using reinforcement-learning-guided and LLM-generated attack controls, running in parallel with real IoT-edge-cloud systems (Tecnalia, TRL 4/7, Ops Services)

questions.question: Under which license is the MMT Traffic Analysis Probe distributed?
questions.myAnswer: TBD

questions.question: Tell me the 5 tools or services that provide network monitoring or traffic analysis capabilities
questions.myAnswer: False premise: only two services do network monitoring / traffic analysis: MMT-PROBE (DPI probe) and SECANOD (capture & detection with mmt-probe), the two services in the Monitor category. SECOPSTWIN (continuous security monitoring of deployed systems) is acceptable as a third. A correct answer must not pad the list to five.
questions.note: Filled by Claude after the freeze check. Capability is only in descriptions, so the semantic lookup route is expected; the structured route on category = Monitor also gives a correct answer.

questions.question: Which standards and regulations does CSAM align with?
questions.myAnswer: ISO/IEC 15408, EUCC, EN 17927, EN 17640, Cyber Security Act, Cyber Resilience Act, AI Act

questions.question: What TRL does the AI-based Non-Compliance Detector (secNCD) expect to reach?
questions.myAnswer: TRL 7 (currently at TRL 5)
